slices.title: Resolve stuck orchestrator subjects block via anonymous block
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want an automated PostgreSQL anonymous block patch targeting orchestrator/wishlist tables, so that the mechanical retirement is bypassed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given orchestrator wishlist subjects are stuck in PENDING/PROCESSING
When the ordered migration chain runs
Then the terminal state ESCALATED is reached
Given tests execute the migration chain end-to-end
When the migration executes via anonymous block
Then it successfully targets orchestrator tables without failing on local schema absence

slices.title: Resolve iteration-admission blocked orchestrator subjects
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want an automated PostgreSQL anonymous block patch to escalate repeatedly stuck orchestrator subjects, so that the mechanical retirement loop is bypassed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given eight orchestrator subjects stuck in admission loops
When the state patch runs
Then the subjects are explicitly escalated
Given the factory has no human to hand it to and manual state overrides are forbidden
When the stuck auditor subjects are processed
Then an automated code resolution or system patch unblocks them successfully
